items.author: Rep. Melanie Stansbury
items.title: OPPOSITION TO PERMITTING DEAL
items.summary: In a one-minute House floor speech the day the Senate passed the bill, Rep. Stansbury (D-N.M.) opposed it and asked members to vote no.

quote.text: No matter how they try to spin it, this bill, even as amended, undermines Tribal sovereignty
quote.speaker: Rep. Melanie Stansbury (D-N.M.), House floor

claims.text: this bill, even as amended, undermines Tribal sovereignty
claims.speaker: Rep. Melanie Stansbury (D-N.M.)

claims.text: undercuts the Clean Water Act, NEPA, and the Endangered Species Act
claims.speaker: Rep. Melanie Stansbury (D-N.M.)

claims.text: locks in dangerous oil and gas and mining projects that could threaten sacred sites
claims.speaker: Rep. Melanie Stansbury (D-N.M.)

claims.text: we know that Donald Trump plans to use it to build data centers because he said so himself
claims.speaker: Rep. Melanie Stansbury (D-N.M.)

claims.text: a deal cut behind closed doors without public hearings, without Tribal consultation, and without public input
claims.speaker: Rep. Melanie Stansbury (D-N.M.)

items.author: Sen. Shelley Moore Capito
items.title: Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026
items.summary: The day after passage, Sen. Capito thanked the people who worked on the bill on the Senate floor, said she had spoken with House Natural Resources Chairman Westerman that morning, and urged the House to act; Sen. Whitehouse added his thanks.

quote.text: So I hope our House counterparts, when they return, will act quickly and send this bill to President Trump's desk without delay.
quote.speaker: Sen. Shelley Moore Capito (R-W.Va.), Senate floor
